note: The controls list in the lower right of the screen (creator, 30 Oct 2026). scripts/ui/guidance_hud.gd builds it from the real input map (project.godot [input]), so a key rebound there changes here too. A row is a label plus either 'actions' (input-map action names, shown as their keys) or 'text' (a literal key name for what is not an input action: the mouse, P for pause, Esc). Two modes: ON_FOOT, and AT_HELM while the player is seated in the launch. The debug keys (F9, F10, F11, Page Up and Down, Home) are deliberately not listed.
